Not covered: runtime verification with an actual keyboard/screen reader (static code audit only — e.g. I did not empirically confirm MapLibre canvas keyboard pan in this embed config); recharts' internal focusability (charts are role=img wrappers, owned by the chart-alternatives dimension); contrast, ARIA name/role/value correctness (e.g. the TabDropdown's aria-activedescendant-pointing-at-selected-not-focused option, th elements lacking button roles, one-way aria-pressed semantics are noted only where they intersect keyboard operation); touch/pointer-gesture criteria; backend-served content.
